text:
Jamie L.: Hey — quick Q. Partner was discharged earlier than expected, thinking of coming back early next month but as a partial return (50% for ~6 weeks). Two quick things: how does parental pay get pro-rated for a partial early return, and is the childcare stipend prorated too? Also do I need to send my laptop back before I return or can I keep it? I have an on-call week the same week I plan to come back.

Sofia (People Ops): Sorry to hear about the scramble — glad partner is home. Short answers: parental pay prorates, childcare stipend usually prorates, and you can keep company laptop while on leave. Need to file an early-return request so we can lock payroll dates and on-call coverage.

Ari (Payroll): Hi Jamie — we prorate parental pay based on actual paid work days in the payroll period. For a 50% schedule we calculate your leave payout like this: take your full eligible weekly parental pay, multiply by the fraction of leave days actually taken that week. Stipend: childcare stipend is paid monthly; we pro-rata by calendar days of eligibility in that month.

Ari (Payroll): Practical bits — submit the early-return form at least 10 business days before your planned return to hit the next payroll cycle. If you miss that cutoff we may need to do a manual adj on the following month.

Sofia (People Ops): Form link: https://intranet.redwood/leave/early-return (put `Partial FTE` in the "return type" field). Please cc Maya (Manager) and Ari. Example text to paste in the form:```I'm requesting an early partial return to work (50% FTE) starting 2026-04-12 for approximately 6 weeks due to family medical changes. Manager: Maya Rivera. Payroll contact: Ari.```

Maya (Manager): Jamie — we can absolutely do 50% for the 6 weeks. I can swap your on-call with Priya that week and we can stagger meetings. LMK if you want me to approve the form on submission. :thumbsup:

benefits-bot: Childcare stipend rules: monthly allowance paid for active leave status. If your active leave ends mid-month because you moved to partial pay / partial work, stipend is prorated by calendar days. Example: 30-day month, 10 days on leave = stipend * (10/30).

oncall-sched: I can swap the on-call week — @Maya please confirm and I'll post the swap.

Jamie L.: Thanks all — filing form today. One more: for the proration math, will payroll give a line-item in the payslip so I can reconcile?

Ari (Payroll): Yes — we'll include a detailed adjustment line in the payslip and a brief explanation. If you want, request a payroll breakdown when you submit the form and I'll follow up with the projection.

Sofia (People Ops): No hardware exchange required for partial returns; keep the laptop and badge. If you plan to be remote full-time after the 6 weeks we can skip re-onboarding. If you switch back to full-time on campus later, we'll confirm access.

Jamie L.: Perfect. Submitting now — cc @Maya. Thanks everyone. :heart:

Maya (Manager): Approved on my side, ping me if you want calendar blocks for the reduced schedule.

Ari (Payroll): Received — I'll queue the projection once the form hits my inbox. ```
_notes: Thread covers early partial return, proration of parental pay and childcare stipend, payroll cutoff, equipment policy, and on-call swap coordination. Messages are short informal Slack-style with a sample form snippet and a link to internal form.
